title: rfs-sre-reallocation: exact reconstruction of Renewable Fuel Standard percentage standards and evaluation of exemption-reallocation timing rules
description:
Exact reconstruction of EPA's 2026-2027 Renewable Fuel Standard percentage standards and of both co-proposed alternatives for reallocating the additional 2025 small refinery exemption volume (91 FR 65699, docket EPA-HQ-OAR-2024-0505), with an uncertainty model built from EPA's published record, a family of timing rules, a historical backtest and carryover-RIN accounting. The repository regenerates every number, table and figure of the manuscript, the supporting information, the regulatory comment and its technical attachment with a single command.
